section_summary.extract_value: This is a single cross-sectional study examining the relationship between body appreciation, appearance dissatisfaction, and sexual health in 215 heterosexual women aged 18-88 years. Data were collected online, and the study found that body appreciation was a unique predictor of sexual function, satisfaction, and distress beyond BMI and appearance dissatisfaction effects. The abstract does not provide detailed demographic information (country, race/ethnicity, education, mean age, mean BMI) or specific assessment instruments used.
section_summary.evidence_source: Abstract of the study titled 'Appearance Dissatisfaction, Body Appreciation, and Sexual Health in Women Across Adulthood' by Anne-Rose Robbins and Elke D. Reissing.
